risks.title: Cyclical Automotive Aftermarket Demand
risks.score_rationale: NAPA and European auto parts businesses depend on miles driven, vehicle age and repair vs. replace decisions. Soft consumer demand and warm winters depress same-store growth, as evidenced in 2024-25.
risks.summary: Weak miles driven, mild weather and consumer deferral of discretionary repairs can pressure aftermarket sales growth.

risks.title: Industrial (MOTION) Cyclical Exposure
risks.score_rationale: The Motion industrial distribution segment is tied to U.S. manufacturing PMI and capex. Recent quarters reflected industrial soft-landing pressure.
risks.summary: Downturns in U.S. industrial production and customer capex directly impact Motion segment volume and operating leverage.

risks.title: Inflation, Tariffs and Pricing
risks.score_rationale: GPC sources significant SKUs from China and Mexico. Tariff escalation in 2025 increases COGS; ability to pass through pricing in a competitive aftermarket is uncertain.
risks.summary: Tariffs on imported parts and persistent supplier inflation could compress gross margins if pricing actions fail to fully offset costs.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration and Goodwill
risks.score_rationale: GPC's growth strategy includes consolidating independent NAPA owners (e.g., MPEC) and European tuck-ins. Integration missteps or goodwill impairment risk is present.
risks.summary: Bolt-on acquisitions of independent jobbers and European distributors carry integration and goodwill impairment risk.

risks.title: EV Transition and Parts Mix
risks.score_rationale: Long-term EV penetration will reduce demand for ICE-specific aftermarket parts (oil filters, exhaust, transmissions), shifting product mix and margin profile.
risks.summary: Accelerating EV adoption could erode demand for high-margin ICE aftermarket SKUs and require investment in EV-specific inventory.

risks.title: FX and International Operations
risks.score_rationale: Significant European (Alliance Automotive) and Australasian (Repco) operations create EUR, GBP and AUD translation exposure plus operational complexity.
risks.summary: Currency translation and local economic weakness in European and Australasian markets impact reported revenue and operating income.
